title: VAFL: A Vertical Analytic Federated Learning Mechanism for Efficient Crowdsourced Services via Closed-Form Solutions
abstract: arXiv:2611.24367v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Intelligent services often rely on complementary information held by different organizations, motivating Vertical Federated Learning without centralized raw-data pooling. We propose VAFL, a Vertical Analytic Federated Learning framework that fits classification and regression heads on fixed local representations through regularized least squares. An agent-assisted protected-computation workflow supports two-party and multi-party collaboration. To reduce fitting overhead, we develop a full-dimensional equivalent solve that applies block factors directly to the target matrix, avoiding construction of the full inverse. We further study two width-reduction strategies: local spectral projection with coefficient lifting, and full-dimensional local fitting with low-rank cross-party correction. translated_title: VAFL：一种基于闭式解的高效众包服务纵向分析联邦学习机制
translated_abstract: 智能服务通常依赖于不同组织所持有的互补信息，这推动了无需集中式原始数据汇集的纵向联邦学习的发展。我们提出VAFL，一种纵向分析联邦学习框架，通过正则化最小二乘法在固定局部表示上拟合分类和回归头。该框架采用代理辅助的隐私保护计算工作流，支持两方和多方协作。为降低拟合开销，我们开发了一种全维度等价求解方法，将块因子直接应用于目标矩阵，避免了构建完整逆矩阵。我们进一步研究了两种宽度缩减策略：带系数提升的局部谱投影，以及带低秩跨方修正的全维度局部拟合。前者压缩预测空间，而后者保留了协作子空间之外的局部成分。我们建立了它们的代数性质……
tldr: 提出了一种基于闭式解的纵向分析联邦学习框架VAFL，通过正则化最小二乘在固定局部表示上拟合任务头，并利用块因子等价求解和两种宽度缩减策略大幅降低计算开销，实现高效的两方及多方隐私保护协作学习。
en_tdlr: VAFL is a vertical analytic federated learning framework that fits classification and regression heads on fixed local representations via regularized least squares, employing block-factor equivalent solves and two width-reduction strategies to enable efficient, privacy-preserving two-party and multi-party collaboration.
